Good -- the `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` is defined but not wired into the server startup (unlike `s3presignRunner.RunOnce`). It appears to be an offline/manual tool for bulk-rebuilding all memo payloads.

Here is my complete report.

---

## Findings: Memo Derived/Computed Metadata

This is a Go-based project (the "Memos" note-taking app at `github.com/usememos/memos`). Derived metadata from memo content is computed in two forms: **persisted payload properties** (stored in the database alongside the memo) and **on-the-fly computed fields** (generated at API response time). Below is the full breakdown.

---

### 1. Where metadata is computed from memo content

There are two distinct systems:

#### A. Persisted payload: `RebuildMemoPayload` (tags + properties)

**Core function:** `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 74-88

```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
    if memo.Payload == nil {
        memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
    }
    data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
    if err != nil {
        return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
    }
    memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
    memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
    return nil
}
```

This calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll()` which does a single-pass AST walk over the memo content. The implementation is at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 356-422 (`ExtractAll` method).

**What it extracts (persisted into the `payload` JSON column):**

| Property | Type | How it's derived |
|---|---|---|
| `Tags` | `[]string` | All `#tag` nodes found in the markdown AST, deduplicated |
| `Property.HasLink` | `bool` | True if the AST contains any `Link` node |
| `Property.HasCode` | `bool` | True if the AST contains `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, or `CodeSpan` nodes |
| `Property.HasTaskList` | `bool` | True if the AST contains any `TaskCheckBox` node (GFM extension) |
| `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` | `bool` | True if any `TaskCheckBox` node has `IsChecked == false` |
| `Property.Title` | `string` | Plain text of the first block-level child of the document if it is an H1 heading (`# ...`). Inline formatting is stripped. If the first block is not H1 or the document is empty, this is empty string. |

These are also individually extractable via `ExtractProperties()` at line 193 and `ExtractTags()` at line 143 of the same file.

Additionally, `ExtractAll` extracts **`Mentions`** (`@username` references), though these are not stored in the payload -- they are used for notification dispatch (see section 2).

**Protobuf definition for the stored payload:** `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto`

```protobuf
message MemoPayload {
  Property property = 1;
  Location location = 2;    // user-set, not derived
  repeated string tags = 3;
  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    string title = 5;
  }
}
```

#### B. On-the-fly computed: `snippet` (not persisted)

**Core function:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, lines 83-90

```go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
    snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
    ...
}
```

This calls `markdown.Service.GenerateSnippet()` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 264-346. It walks the AST and produces a **plain-text summary** with a maximum of 64 characters (truncated at word boundary with "..." appended). Code blocks are excluded; inline code, tags, autolinks, and table cells are included. Block-level elements are space-separated.

The `snippet` field is declared as `OUTPUT_ONLY` in the API proto at `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`, line 265-266:
```protobuf
string snippet = 17 [(google.api.field_behavior) = OUTPUT_ONLY];
```

The snippet is computed **every time a memo is converted to an API response** -- it is never stored in the database.

#### C. RSS title generation (also on-the-fly, not persisted)

The RSS feed service at `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go`, lines 302-330, has its own `generateItemTitle()` method that extracts the first line of memo content, strips markdown heading syntax, and truncates to 100 characters. This is a simpler, regex-based approach separate from the goldmark-based `Property.Title`.

---

### 2. What triggers recomputation

#### On CreateMemo (persisted payload rebuilt)

`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, line 108:
```go
if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil { ... }
```
This is called **before** `s.Store.CreateMemo()`, so the payload (tags + properties) is computed and stored at creation time.

#### On UpdateMemo when content changes (persisted payload rebuilt)

`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, lines 436-451:
When the `update_mask` includes `"content"`, the service calls:
```go
memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil { ... }
update.Content = &memo.Content
update.Payload = memo.Payload
```
The rebuilt payload is then persisted via `s.Store.UpdateMemo()`. Other update paths (changing visibility, pinned state, location, timestamps) do **not** trigger payload recomputation.

#### On API response (snippet computed on-the-fly)

The snippet is computed every time a memo is serialized to an API response, in the converter at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`, lines 76-80:
```go
snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)
memoMessage.Snippet = snippet
```

This also happens in batch when converting memo relations (lines 225-249 of the same file) and for notification payloads (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`, lines 318-328, 346-353).

#### Bulk rebuild runner (manual/offline)

The `Runner.RunOnce()` method at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 27-72, iterates over **all memos** in batches of 100 and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each. This is currently **not wired into the server startup** (the server only starts `s3presignRunner` at startup, per `/bench/repo/server/server.go` line 163). The memopayload runner appears to be available for manual or migration use.

#### Mention extraction (notification dispatch, not persisted)

At `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go`, lines 26-38, the `resolveMentionTargets()` function calls `s.MarkdownService.ExtractAll()` to find `@username` mentions in memo content. This is used to send inbox notifications on create and update, but the mentions list is **not** stored in the memo payload.

---

### 3. Summary of all derived/computed properties

| Property | Persisted? | Where computed | Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Payload.Tags` (list of `#tag` strings) | Yes (in `payload` JSON column) | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Payload.Property.HasLink` | Yes | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Payload.Property.HasCode` | Yes | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Payload.Property.HasTaskList` | Yes | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Payload.Property.HasIncompleteTasks` | Yes | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Payload.Property.Title` (first H1 text) | Yes | `RebuildMemoPayload` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (content change), bulk runner |
| `Snippet` (64-char plain text summary) | No (output-only) | `getMemoContentSnippet` -> `GenerateSnippet` | Every API response |
| `Mentions` (`@username` references) | No (used transiently) | `resolveMentionTargets` -> `ExtractAll` | Create, Update (for notification dispatch) |
| RSS title (first line, 100 char) | No (output-only) | `generateItemTitle` | Every RSS feed generation |

---

### Key files

- **Markdown extraction service (interface + implementation):** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- **Markdown extraction tests:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown_test.go`
- **Payload rebuild function + bulk runner:** `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
- **CreateMemo / UpdateMemo API (triggers rebuild):** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
- **Memo-to-API-response converter (snippet + property mapping):** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`
- **Snippet generation helper:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 83-90)
- **Mention extraction for notifications:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go`
- **Store-level protobuf definition (persisted payload):** `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto`
- **API-level protobuf definition (output-only fields):** `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`
- **Store model (Memo struct with Payload field):** `/bench/repo/store/memo.go`
- **Filter schema (computed properties used for CEL-based querying):** `/bench/repo/internal/filter/schema.go`
- **Notification snippet usage:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`
- **RSS title generation:** `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go`

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` — the function `RebuildMemoPayload` calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` (implemented in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, the `ExtractAll` method) to walk the memo's Markdown AST in a single pass and populate `memo.Payload`.
